scope: Tail occlusion edits only. Native silhouettes are registered as local alpha mattes; original body RGB is preserved.

jobs.prompt: Edit target is FIRST image: existing European rabbit down_walk sprite row. SECOND image is anatomy/occlusion reference only, do NOT recolor or change poses to it. Surgical edit: remove the incorrectly protruding cream tail puff from every frame in this row, so the short rabbit tail is fully hidden behind the rear CENTRAL pelvis at this FRONT / FRONT-THREE-QUARTER camera angle, exactly like front and diagonal views of the design sheet. For seated pose also fully occlude tail behind seated pelvis. The tail must NOT emerge from the waist, hand, elbow or side of torso. Preserve ALL original faces, ears, fur colors, shading, line style, body silhouettes, each arm/hand and each leg/foot pose, every frame order and spacing. Only replace visible tail puff with transparency, restoring a clean uninterrupted existing arm/hip silhouette at its overlap boundary. Do NOT remove the ivory hands. Do NOT add toes/paw pads. Output transparent background, same horizontal row composition and canvas aspect ratio as first image, no text, no shadows, no extra frames. No redesign, no motion changes.
